semiconductor_relevance: High — UCT KOREA provides critical components and services for gas delivery and vacuum systems in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: UCT KOREA CO., LTD. specializes in providing high-purity gas chemical valves, vacuum valves, and the Q-LOK valve and fitting system. They offer maintenance services for HOT gate and vacuum valves, as well as electropolishing services for piping systems. These products and services are essential for maintaining the integrity and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: High-purity gas chemical valves and fittings

regional_presence.Korea: UCT KOREA operates in Korea, focusing on semiconductor and LCD pre-manufacturing equipment.
